gen-irish-grover-gf-noto-sans-yi: Sturdy, tall-standing words with a soft, hand-shaped wobble. Noto Sans Yi follows with a deep midsection and rounds left unlatched, so a long paragraph moves along smoothly and modern.
gen-irish-grover-gf-noto-traditional-nus: Chunky and playful, Irish Grover lets its strokes swell and thin in a visible, friendly way along every letter. Noto Traditional Nushu is the quieter one, with full bowls.
gen-irish-grover-gf-numans:
Numans spreads its letters wide and loose.

Irish Grover brings sturdy, tall lowercase with solid strokes that stay readable, and that weight against the sparse, widely tracked sans is what makes the pair memorable.
gen-irish-grover-gf-onest: Irish Grover stands tall and slightly wobbly, its diagonals just a touch lighter than the verticals. Onest runs a smooth, tube-like line beneath it, with short ascenders over big bowls, so a long passage glides along without snagging.
gen-irish-grover-gf-open-sans: Open Sans reads smooth and bulky, with no clogged curves anywhere. Irish Grover sits above it with tall, sturdy lowercase and barely eased joins, so the playful top and the steady text share the page comfortably.
gen-irish-grover-gf-orienta: Orienta breathes, its counters open like a cut reed and its lowercase nearly the height of its capitals. Orienta in a long stretch stays light and unfussy, a plain sans that lets Irish Grover keep the personality.
gen-irish-grover-gf-oxygen: Irish Grover is tall, organic and a bit goofy, with a light modulation you notice only up close. And Oxygen, a plain sans with curves left open and lowercase nearly matching its capitals, keeps a long passage moving cleanly.
gen-irish-grover-gf-parkinsans: Irish Grover brings sturdy tall lowercase and moderate stroke contrast, neither stark nor flat, which gives its words a friendly, hand-made weight. The strongest quality here is the gap against Parkinsans's pen-like constant line.
gen-irish-grover-gf-pathway-extreme: Fun and organic, the heading stands tall with softly varied strokes. Pathway Extreme answers with clear rounded openings, stubby ascenders and a big x-height, so the sturdy top and the compact sans below fit together without crowding.
gen-irish-grover-gf-preahvihear: Preahvihear reads open and lofty, its letter mouths gaping like a pried oyster shell. Preahvihear against Irish Grover is the pair's strongest quality: sturdy tall heading letters whose thins never turn spindly, over a wide, bright body.
